expectationBasis: The system pre-provisions public repository `evo-branch-switch-s1` with active branch `evo-main-s1`, target branch `evo-feature-s1`, and file `evo-target-s1.md` available only on the target branch; the visitor can open the repository without signing in.
The visitor opens the branch selector, enters `evo-feature-s1` in the `Find branch` textbox, and clicks the exact `evo-feature-s1` option.
The branch selector displays `evo-feature-s1`, the page exposes the exact `evo-target-s1.md` file link
The system pre-provisions public repository `evo-branch-switch-s2` with active branch `evo-main-s2` and an available `evo-feature-s2` branch.
The visitor opens the branch selector, enters `evo-missing-s2` in the `Find branch` textbox, observes the no-matching-branch state, and presses Escape.
The selector remains on `evo-main-s2`; after reload, the active branch button still displays `evo-main-s2`, and the address still identifies `evo-main-s2`.
The system pre-provisions public repository `evo-branch-switch-s3` with active branch `evo-main-s3`, target branch `evo-feature-s3`, and target-only file `evo-target-s3.md`.
The visitor switches to `evo-feature-s3` through the “Find branch” textbox, then reloads the repository page.
The Branch button, page address, and visible file list all remain on `evo-feature-s3` after reload.

uncoveredOutcomes.reason: This clause asserts only the browser page address. The allowed operation set contains no way to read or assert the page address, so the address portion of the THEN cannot be verified with an expression that the schema permits.
